author: MiYu
scope: One full native client, identical published Main.js/Main.mscene, actual F1 skirmish input, continuous 45-second playback sample, pause/step/stop. Native viewport sampling includes rendering and scheduling; this is not a two-client networking or full-fidelity acceptance.

profile.note: WebView timing plus instrumented native editor-host/RHI call tree, memory provenance, and render-bound resources. GPU bytes are estimates; driver timing and process-wide heap sampling are not claimed.
